name: tree
description: Recursive directory listing tool that produces a depth-indented, optionally colorized tree of files and subdirectories.
install: make -C tree-2.3.2 DESTDIR="$DESTDIR" PREFIX="$PREFIX" MANDIR="$PREFIX/share/man" install
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
